Experience Luxury Dining and Spa at Cliffrose Lodge
Springdale Utah | Zion National Park
Experience Cliffrose
In the heart of Springdale UT
Stay With Us
Welcome to Cliffrose Springdale, Curio Collection by Hilton, nestled in the heart of Springdale, just steps from the entrance of Zion National Park. Our 4-star hotel offers breathtaking surroundings, a serene garden, and top-tier amenities including a restaurant, spa, and more. Enjoy 24-hour service, including concierge and room service, while starting your day with a made-to-order breakfast. Whether you re here for adventure or relaxation, Cliffrose is your perfect retreat near Zion.

Near the Entrance to Zion Canyon
Cliffrose, nestled along the Virgin River in Springdale Utah, is only steps from the entrance to Zion National Park. The lodge has it s own restaurant, Anthera, and is a short walk from many other great restaurants like Zion Canyon Brew Pub, Canyon Coffee, and more!

Hotel De Novo reigns as the gatekeeper to the infamous Zion Canyon. As you turn the corner leading into the canyon your first interaction is set with this elevated property. It is another proud member of the Tapestry Collection by Hilton. Check out their website for more info.

All our rooms have been newly updated to meet discriminating standards to provide a restful stay after adventure-filled days. If you need a break from soaking in the canyon walls and the sound of the river from your room’s private patio, we do have fast WiFi.

We Welcome You
Inspiring Views Await
Each room at Cliffrose has direct access to our sprawling and unscripted botanical gardens set in the shadows of Zion Canyon. Hummingbird feeders hang from patio rafters for the best live entertainment in the canyon as you drink your coffee in the morning. Or open your window and go back to bed and enjoy the chorus of songbirds and the gentle rustle of the river outside. Our decor is different room to room because homogenization just isn’t our thing. But there is intention in every aspect of your stay. We hope you will enjoy all of the unexpected delights awaiting your visit with us. We’ve prepared them just for you.

pages.text:
Discover our General Policies & Services | 24/7 Front Desk
General Policy
Important details
for our Guests.
Reservation and Front Desk Office Hours
Front Desk is open 24 hours
Online Reservations are made in real-time can be made 24 hours a day
Reservations
All reservations must be guaranteed with a credit card and require a refundable deposit of the first night’s room and tax.
Tax Rate
All Rooms are subject to a 13.37% tax.
Cancellation Policy
Reservations must be canceled at least 72 hours prior to arrival. Reservations canceled after this time will forfeit the cost of the first night’s room and tax. Group reservations of more than 5 rooms must be canceled at least 30 days prior to arrival. Group Reservations canceled after this time will forfeit the 25% deposit.
Smoking Policy
All Suites, Balconies, Patios, and Pool Hot Tub Area are Smoke-Free. Smoking is only permitted around fire pit and BBQ areas provided you are mindful of other guests.
Check-in Check-out Times
Check-in Time : 4:00 pm for all Rooms & Suites
Check-out Time : 11:00 am for all Rooms, Suites
You are welcome to use any of the Grounds Areas, Pool & Hot Tub Area, Guest Laundry, Lobby Internet & Computer Access, and Guest Parking Lots prior to Check-in and after Check-out.
Bicycle Storage
We do not allow bicycles to be stored in any of the Guest Rooms, Suites, Balconies, or Patios. We do offer free secure storage and we also provide a large outdoor bike rack if you prefer to use your own security device.
Reservation and Front Desk Office Hours
Sorry for the inconvenience but we do not accept pets. Dog Daycare and Boarding is available at Canyon Paws located in Rockville Utah.   (435) 703-6680 .   http://www.canyonpaws.com/
We look forward to serving your lodging and accommodation needs while visiting Zion National Park, Springdale, and the other surrounding parks and attractions. If you have any further questions or concerns or if there is anything we can do to help make your stay more comfortable and memorable please let us know.
